subject: Cross-border checkpoint: TIA scope, UK addendum, and evidence timeline
messages:
From: Sofia Grantham <sofia.grantham@betamed.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Reeves <t.reeves@betamed.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick: TIA scope + UK addendum evidence request

Hi Olga,

Thanks for taking this on. We're kicking off our DPA/TIA review for the BetaMed <> Redwood pilot and need to align on evidence and timelines. High-level asks: 

- Confirm whether Redwood can accept SCCs (EU) plus the UK IDTA / UK addendum approach for transfers to Redwood-hosted US instances.
- Provide a current subprocessor inventory (we need company name, role, country, and whether they see customer data).
- Share SOC 2 summary + how long logs and request traces are retained (we'll map to our retention baseline).
- A short mutual action plan with dates so procurement can calendar the procurement/PO/POC steps.

I'm attaching our initial scope spreadsheet (BetaMed_TIA_scope.xlsx) — it highlights required artifacts and a handful of questions from our privacy team. Can you confirm whether you prefer SCC annex vs UK addendum + DTIAs, or whether you have a single consolidated approach for both regimes? Also, any known exceptions/temporary routing that would require extra controls?

We'd like to collect baseline evidence by 2027-11-28 if possible. Happy to do a 30-minute sync this week if that speeds things up.

Cheers,
Sofia
Sofia Grantham
Senior Privacy Counsel | BetaMed
sofia.grantham@betamed.com

Attachment: BetaMed_TIA_scope.xlsx (spreadsheet, 24KB)

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Grantham <sofia.grantham@betamed.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 13:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick: TIA scope + UK addendum evidence request

Hi Sofia — thanks for the clear scope and the spreadsheet. Looping in Laura (Legal) and Vivek (Product/Security) to make sure we cover the routing and evidence pieces. 

Short answers up front:
- Redwood supports SCCs for EU transfers and also offers the UK IDTA / UK Addendum flow for UK data subjects. We typically propose the UK addendum + TIA/DPIA mapping for customers with UK-specific obligations, but can do the SCC annex approach if BetaMed prefers a single global annex.
- We'll deliver a subprocessor inventory CSV (see attachment) and a short SOC 2 summary. Logs/trace retention: default is 90 days for request traces in hosted by default; longer retention can be configured on Redwood Dedicated or Private deployments — we'll include explicit retention mappings in the evidence pack.

Proposed mutual action plan (high level):
1) 2027-11-16: Redwood to deliver questionnaire + subprocessor inventory + SOC2 summary (attached).
2) 2027-11-18: 30m technical sync to clarify any routing exceptions — propose 11/18 10:00 PT.
3) 2027-11-22: BetaMed to confirm transfer mechanism preference (SCCs vs UK addendum).
4) 2027-11-28: Evidence handoff complete and DPA signature path (DocuSign link).

Attachments I'm sending now: redwood_tia_questionnaire_v1.docx, subprocessor_inventory_20271115.csv, SOC2_Summary_2026.pdf. I flagged a few items in the questionnaire where we'll need your input (particularly around EEA/UK data subject treatment in mixed-region jobs).

If you prefer the SCC route, we can include a draft SCC annex for review; if you choose UK addendum we will produce both the addendum + a TIA mapping doc.

Thanks — I can jump on the sync if the proposed time works.

—Olga
Olga Petrov
Senior Manager, Privacy & Compliance | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood_tia_questionnaire_v1.docx (34KB), subprocessor_inventory_20271115.csv (12KB), SOC2_Summary_2026.pdf (88KB)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai, soﬁa.grantham@betamed.com
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 08:41:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick: TIA scope + UK addendum evidence request

On Mon, Nov 15, 2027 at 01:03 PM Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai> wrote:
> If you prefer the SCC route, we can include a draft SCC annex for review; if you choose UK addendum we will produce both the addendum + a TIA mapping doc.

Thanks Olga — quick legal note for Sofia / BetaMed: our standard DPA supports SCCs and we also maintain a UK Addendum for UK transfers. Two practical points: 
1) If BetaMed requires contractual data localization (i.e., no US-hosted inference), that's an out-of-scope change and we should move to the Private deployment conversation — that will require a separate procurement path.
2) For the UK IDTA addendum, BetaMed should confirm whether it wants the full addendum + TIA Annex (recommended) or a lighter routing affirmation. If you confirm the addendum path, we'll populate the UK-specific evidence fields in the TIA mapping (e.g., UK supplementary safeguards).

I'll prepare a short redline doc highlighting three DPA clauses that often come up (log retention; subprocessors; breach notification timing). I'll attach that before the technical sync.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachment: DPA_annotated_highlights_20271116.pdf (8KB)

From: Sofia Grantham <sofia.grantham@betamed.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Reeves <t.reeves@betamed.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 21 Nov 2027 16:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick: TIA scope + UK addendum evidence request

Hi all — thanks for the fast turnaround and the attachments. Confirming: BetaMed will proceed with the UK Addendum + TIA mapping (we have a small UK cohort for the pilot).

A couple of follow-ups from procurement/privacy: 
- Can you confirm the exact log retention fields you mentioned (we need a row in the evidence CSV mapping product, log type, retention default, configurable options).
- We noted one subprocessor (Keysight Solutions) listed as seeing request metadata. Can you add a short description of their scope?

We're happy with the proposed timeline — 11/28 evidence handoff works for procurement. We booked the 11/18 technical sync (Tom, Sofia, Olga, Vivek) and I've sent a calendar invite.

I'll circulate a short PO/engagement letter once we complete the evidence handoff. Thanks again for being thorough — looping legal is helpful.

Sofia
Sofia Grantham
Senior Privacy Counsel | BetaMed
